verdict.rationale: Apify documents Crawlee as its own first-party browser automation library and supports Playwright, Puppeteer and Selenium inside Actors, so developers can script interactive browser sessions. SessionPool also manages cookies across sessions. However, nothing in the pack shows clicking, form filling, or authenticating past a login wall on an already-loaded page. missing for 10: documented click/fill-form interaction APIs, login/authentication workflow examples, evidence of continuing a session on an already-scraped page, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall

citations.quote: Apify works great with both Python and JavaScript, as well as Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy, and Crawlee - our own web crawling and browser automation library.
SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
